head: 5c68e54b17a87d916782191b1e388a7510d020ea
auditedState: Current uncommitted repair tree plus centrally built dist 2.0.0-alpha.2; this auditor did not build or commit.
scope: Final read-only closeout of existing discovery audit IDs; no feature expansion, repository edits, real user home/DB/MCP or model use.

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 源连接变更后新导入仍复用旧地址和旧身份
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 源配置、身份引用及实际过滤后 catalogFingerprint 进入不可变连接身份；新 Schema 导入与能力版本一致，旧连接/绑定不被改写。
tests: current source revision gets a new connection; successful replay is independent of source and network
schema-only and description-only catalog drift create immutable connections with matching contracts

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 同上下文旧扫描能覆盖新扫描并把新能力标失效
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 每上下文 scan generation 与 context revision 在后续写前核对；旧扫描逆序完成被 SCAN_SUPERSEDED 拒绝，context 变化被 CONTEXT_CHANGED 拒绝。
tests: older scans and context drift cannot overwrite newer current catalog

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 禁用来源后旧能力仍ready且导入会重新启动已禁用MCP
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: disabled 与 source/tool policy 传播至能力；新导入查 capability/source enabled/stale/revision 并重读源，拒绝后无 downstream 连接。
tests: source and tool disables invalidate old catalog and never reconnect during import

original_and_reaudit_status.title: Codex工具allowlist/denylist被丢弃或未执行
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: CLI normalizedServer 保留 allow/deny 字段，插件 per-server 覆盖参与有效配置；发现展示、重新导入及存储连接工具集均执行 toolEnabled。
tests: skill enablement, plugin server overrides and CLI allow/deny policy are effective
plugin per-server deny rules and custom Skill/app components preserve installed provenance
source and tool disables invalidate old catalog and never reconnect during import

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 不匹配有限正则的命令行凭据明文复制入connections
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 已报告 client-secret/client_secret/access-token/token、Authorization header、URL userinfo/query 等认证变体保持 metadata-only；认证内容未进入普通表，未知 flag 为 unsupported 且不会导入。该结论限于已报告认证位置与显式支持的启动方言，不宣称可识别任意字符串中的秘密。
tests: command credentials and URL/header forms stay metadata only without plaintext in ordinary records
credential command arguments remain metadata-only and are never copied into connection rows
launcher adapters support Python, Node, uvx and npx while unknown options are unsupported and secrets stay rejected

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 成功导入的幂等重放仍连接下游并可因停服失败
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 固定 DTO 校验后先读 owner/operation/key 命令账本，成功重放不重读源或网络；并发导入以 request fingerprint singleflight 并在提交中再次查幂等。
tests: current source revision gets a new connection; successful replay is independent of source and network

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 目录扫描无总deadline与取消，daemon shutdown可被扫描长期阻塞
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 扫描全程 30s 默认 deadline、单源 10s、四 worker；关闭中止扫描并等待 job 和 connector disposal。真实 SDK tools/list 的合成慢进程测试在 deadline 后退出且留下退出标记。
tests: close aborts a pending catalog, persists terminal state and rejects subsequent work
catalog deadline covers real SDK tools/list and closes the child transport
concurrent source discovery exposes successful sources before a slow one and scan cancel is durable

original_and_reaudit_status.title: Skill启用覆盖被忽略，显式禁用Skill仍可作为host_reference导入
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 读取 skills.config 的 path enablement；App Server 同 path disabled 校正已索引组件；禁用 capability 的两个 target 均在导入入口被拒绝。
tests: skill enablement, plugin server overrides and CLI allow/deny policy are effective
App Server effective disabled Skill corrects an already indexed path

original_and_reaudit_status.title: HTTP别名形式的FlowHub来源完全绕过self识别
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 实际 daemon endpoint/instance identity 可传入 registry；规范化 endpoint alias 与协议 serverInfo 身份检查同时阻止 self 进入 downstream 导入。本轮不执行递归工作流。
tests: HTTP self aliases normalize independently of server label and protocol identity blocks recursion

original_and_reaudit_status.title: Schema漂移后新能力仍复用旧连接目录
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 连接 ID 纳入过滤后工具目录指纹及协议/源/凭据引用；input/output Schema 与 description 漂移得到新连接；相同 catalog 复用原连接。独立复现证明旧连接、旧 binding 和 capability r1 原样保留，新 binding 引用 r2 且 connection schema 匹配 r2。
tests: schema-only and description-only catalog drift create immutable connections with matching contracts

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 元数据刷新无语义变化却失效已发现能力和修订
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: 同 source fingerprint/context revision 的 metadata 刷新保留 catalog 的发现/可用状态；lastObservation 单独记录本次未连接。独立已有 SUCCEEDED Mock 结果在 metadata 后仍 stale=false、cap r1/ready 不变，publish 校验及发布成功；发布后再次 metadata 不改快照。发布动作自身递增 workflow revision 与测试基线变化属于既有行为，本结论针对 metadata 不引入失效。
tests: unchanged metadata preserves catalog semantics, real draft capability refs and accepted self-test baseline

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 显式配置模式与手动Codex路径入口缺失
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: Object.hasOwn 区分缺省与显式 null；config_only 强制 codexPath=null、useAppServer=false，持久化选择；UI 提供模式及绝对可执行文件输入并恢复已选上下文。独立 marker 证明 null/config_only 不运行 CLI/AppServer；绝对路径执行正常。浏览器层本子审计只读检查源码与用例，未启动 UI。
tests: explicit null and config_only never run PATH Codex or App Server and remain persisted

original_and_reaudit_status.title: 保守参数策略误把合法模块启动当凭据且无解除路径
original_and_reaudit_status.reason: Python -m/-u、Node 明确启动 flag、uvx --from、npx --package 使用受限启动方言；unknown flag 单独归 unsupportedArgs，不再假报 credentials_required；UI 指向现有 MCP 工具库手动连接路径。已知认证参数仍拒绝，未放宽秘密复制边界。
tests: launcher adapters support Python, Node, uvx and npx while unknown options are unsupported and secrets stay rejected

verification.kind: Independent rerun of unchanged original second-round reproducer
Direct current-dist related regressions, no build

initial_custom_fixture_failure.actual: FAILED instead of SUCCEEDED for the synthetic Mock result
initial_custom_fixture_failure.cause: Auditor marked the binding simulationOnly but initially omitted synthetic:true from the fixture response. WorkflowTesting correctly rejected that provenance mismatch. Corrected only the temporary fixture; no product change.

production_runtime_boundary.observation: DiscoveryRuntime is code-only constructor injection. Host-context DTO additionalProperties=false rejects hostRuntime; HTTP regression confirms rejection. Production CLI startDaemon passes only dataDir/port; default discoveryCommand uses configured absolute context.codexPath. UI-only test server restricts injected JavaScript fixtures to its isolated data directory.

initial_implementation_gaps.topic: UI paging, source/executor/environment filters, plugin expansion and host capability insertion
initial_implementation_gaps.boundary: No browser execution in this independent sub-audit; parent centralized UI run must be recorded separately.

initial_implementation_gaps.topic: Static source resolution, full real-host/version/Profile/installation formats
initial_implementation_gaps.boundary: Source chains and separate same-name layers preserved; fallback remains resolutionQuality=partial and must not be claimed as complete host-effective merge. True Codex host/parent-directory/Profile behavior remains external validation.

initial_implementation_gaps.topic: Plugin custom Skill/app paths and system/user Skill roots
initial_implementation_gaps.boundary: Unknown manifest formats stay unsupported; real installed plugin formats not read.
No helper execution; cwd/remote/unsupported transport requires manual supported connection configuration.

initial_implementation_gaps.topic: HTTP fixed DTO and boolean/integer query decoding
SQL summary pagination and 200/1000 cache search performance
initial_implementation_gaps.boundary: macOS synthetic in-memory SQLite; this is not a Windows or real-host performance result.

not_verified: No real Codex CLI/App Server, Desktop session, user CODEX_HOME, credentials or enterprise MCP read.
No real model call or OAuth use.

Windows-native/WSL process/path/runtime and transparent encryption/DLP acceptance not run. Cross-platform synthetic runtime reduces fixture dependence on shebang but does not establish Windows success.
Real-host effective layered config/Profile/parent-directory trust and installed plugin format compatibility remain partial/not verified.
No browser, npm ci, whole npm run check/test, build, packaging, push, merge or Release performed by this sub-auditor. Parent central results remain separate.
No real recursive FlowHub workflow, live resource binding verification or business query executed.
Safety classification is tested for reported credential forms and supported launcher dialects; no universal secret-detection claim.
